description: Search Cricsheet's Test/ODI/T20I/IPL match index by team, format, season, venue and/or player, returning match_id plus date/teams/venue/result for each hit -- use this to discover match_ids for cricsheet_match. With no filters, returns the most recent matches across every format. Provide at least one filter to narrow a specific search.

format.description: Match format: "Test", "ODI", "T20I" (international T20), or "IPL". Omit to search across every format this pack holds.

player.description: Exact player name as Cricsheet stores it (see cricsheet_player_stats to resolve a partial name first).

season.description: Season label as Cricsheet records it, e.g. "2023" or "2007/08".

team.description: Team name, e.g. "England" or "Chennai Super Kings" (IPL).

venue.description: Venue name or partial venue name, e.g. "Lord's".

name: cricsheet_find_matches
title: Cricsheet Find Matches
